$comment: Before schema evaluation, issue #76 admission MUST reject duplicate object member names, unpaired Unicode surrogate code points, non-JSON numeric constants, numeric tokens that overflow to non-finite IEEE-754 values, and integer tokens outside the interoperable exact IEEE-754 range, then canonicalize the parsed instance with RFC 8785 for digesting. JSON Schema evaluates parsed instances and cannot observe raw member tokens.

date_time.description: UTC RFC 3339 instant. Calendar validity is rechecked by the semantic validator.

duration.description: Supported ISO-8601 duration subset. Week form cannot be mixed with calendar components, and T must introduce a time component.

https_uri.description: Absolute HTTPS schema identifier without credentials, query, fragment, or non-standard port; percent escapes must be valid.

stable_id.description: Globally namespaced stable traceability identifier. Each registry applies a narrower type-specific prefix.

time_zone.description: UTC or an IANA-style region/location identifier.

window.description: Product-owned window rule. It defines how a later controller assigns due times; the schema supplies no default.

description: Canonical PM Agent OS product-truth bundle consumed by Production Engineering OS. PMOS owns every product value; PEOS validates and executes without inventing missing truth. Existing V1-V3 contracts remain separate inputs until the compiler and migrations in issue #76 map them here.

acceptance_criteria.description: Registry keyed by stable acceptance-criterion ID.

api_contracts.description: Typed product-owned API contracts. Request and response schema references are omitted rather than inferred when a legacy source did not provide them.

subject.description: Exact immutable approval subject. Bundle approvals bind a projection that excludes approvals to avoid a self-referential digest.

id.description: Type is selected by digest_scope through oneOf.

approvals.description: Registry keyed by stable approval ID. Approval authority and freshness are semantic policy, not inferred by this schema.

assumptions.description: Registry keyed by stable assumption ID. An empty object explicitly means PMOS approved no assumptions.

backend_capabilities.description: Typed product-owned backend capabilities keyed by their stable capability ID.

canonical_json_profile.description: Declares the canonicalization profile used after duplicate-aware parsing and before content digesting.

entities.description: Typed product data entities. Persistence is omitted rather than inferred when a legacy source did not decide it.

dependencies.description: Product-owned external dependencies. Kind and owner are omitted rather than inferred when absent in a legacy source.

effect.description: Extensions may add constraints but can never weaken or replace core truth.

payload.description: Bounded conjunctive constraint vocabulary. It can only require, forbid, limit, or further constrain values; override and removal operations are not representable.

target_pointer.description: JSON Pointer into the canonical core.

extensions.description: Typed repository-specific extension registry. Unknown extension schemas fail during compiler admission in issue #76.

functional_requirements.description: Registry keyed by stable functional-requirement ID.

guardrails.description: Registry keyed by stable guardrail ID.

integrations.description: Registry keyed by stable integration ID. Credentials are never embedded.

target.description: Product-owned target state. Baseline-required and retired targets carry no fabricated numeric threshold.

maturity_policies.description: Named, versioned, owner-approved metric maturity policies. The exact policy subject contains the metric target and every timing/reporting rule, so its approval digest binds all eligibility inputs.

reporting_policies.description: Named, versioned, owner-approved reporting policies. Each policy fixes calculation, denominator, inclusions, and exclusions; maturity-policy references are checked for existence by issue #63.

success.description: Distinct product success metrics that are neither leading metrics nor North Stars. A definition-only record losslessly represents a legacy success-metric statement without inventing a display name.

source_category.description: Exact source category when category is OTHER. Issue #63 enforces that coupling without discarding a legacy category.

non_functional_requirements.description: Registry keyed by stable non-functional-requirement ID.

open_questions.description: Registry keyed by stable question ID. Blocking/resolution consistency is semantic policy in issue #63.

product_decisions.description: Registry of explicit approved product decisions, separate from the approval evidence that authorizes them.

compiler_provenance.description: Reserved for issue #76. Omit for a natively authored canonical bundle; never fabricate compiler values.

source_system.description: PM Agent OS owns the product truth published through this boundary.

required_approvals.description: Approvals PMOS requires but which may not yet be granted. Granted or rejected evidence is recorded separately in approvals.

risks.description: Registry keyed by stable risk ID.

technical_constraints.description: Registry keyed by stable technical-constraint ID.

title: Canonical PMOS Contract Bundle
